paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the perplexity and GPU memory ratio across a range of recent sequence ratios, with perplexity represented on the left vertical axis and GPU memory ratio represented on the right vertical axis. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, ranges from 0% to 100% and uses a linear scale with tick labels spaced at intervals of 20%. The y-axis on the left, “Perplexity (%)”, ranges from approximately 4.2% to 100% with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1%. The y-axis on the right, “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, ranges from approximately 40% to 100% with tick labels spaced at intervals of 10%. A red line with circular markers, representing Perplexity, begins at a value of approximately 4.7% at 0% sequence ratio and decreases to approximately 4.3% at 100% sequence ratio. A dashed red line, representing Full Cache PPL, starts at a value of approximately 60% at 0% sequence ratio and gradually decreases to approximately 64% at 100% sequence ratio. A blue line with circular markers, representing GPU Mem. Ratio, starts at a value of approximately 80% at 0% sequence ratio and decreases to approximately 48% at 100% sequence ratio. A dashed blue line, representing Full Cache GPU Mem., begins at a value of approximately 80% at 0% sequence ratio and decreases to approximately 50% at 100% sequence ratio.
